articles.summary: This post explores why traditional outbound tools struggle when selling into offline industries like manufacturing, where most prospects have little or no digital footprint. It shares early findings from Throxy’s research comparing tech and manufacturing firms - and how AI is being used to bridge that gap.
articles.title: Comparing Cold Outreach in Tech vs Manufacturing: Why Data Gaps Break Outbound

articles.summary: throxy has officially launched a podcast! "Inside The Pipeline" Episode 1 went live on Thursday, November 27th.
articles.title: Throxy launches "Inside The Pipeline" podcast!

articles.summary: Throxy is a GoHub Ventures-backed startup revolutionizing B2B outbound sales with AI agents that automate the entire sales funnel. With $6.2M in funding and $1.5M ARR from just 3 employees, they use a pay-for-results model targeting hard-to-reach industries like manufacturing and logistics, combining AI automation with human expertise.
articles.title: Building the Future of Outbound: How Throxy Is Redefining Sales With AI Agents
